title: Role and prognostic value of N6-methyladenosine RNA modification regulators in glycolytic reprogramming during sepsis.

models.verbatim_formula: Risk Score = −0.266 × HNRNPC − 0.117 × YTHDF1 − 0.078 × YTHDF2 − 0.071 × VIRMA
models.expression_scale_used: normalized array expression after ComBat cross-cohort batch correction (GSE65682/GSE95233/GSE54514)
models.reported_performance: C-index: GSE65682 training (70%) 0.750; internal validation (30%) 0.706; GSE95233 0.718; GSE54514 0.709 (log-rank P=0.245 in GSE54514); tdAUCs in Figure 8 / Suppl Table S4
models.source_location: Methods 'Prognostic model' + Results (formula) + Figure 8 + Supplementary Table S4

notes: GSE65682 split 7:3 random. All three sepsis cohorts were ComBat-corrected jointly and used for differential expression; coefficients may depend on that batch-corrected scale. GSE198316/GSE224650 (ALKBH5-KO macrophages) and GSE225143/GSE201060/GSE127732 (m6A-seq) are non-sepsis mechanistic datasets. scRNA dataset is written 'GSE147363' (possibly meant GSE167363) - recorded as stated. Code on request only.
